The calendar is set up on "Agenda-manifestations" and saved. The API accepted the write, and I read the document back to confirm.

- **Dataset:** `datasets[0]` points to Agenda-manifestations (`https://koumoul.com/data-fair/api/v1/datasets/hokfkn9ym3s9pr-yt1atgzl-`). I copied its full schema, title, time period and permissions from the dataset listing.
- **Label:** `labelField` is set to the `nomevenement` column ("Nom de l'évenement"). The schema types this field as an object, not a column name, so I stored the column's schema entry in the shape the picker returns. The API accepted it, but I could not confirm this is the exact shape the calendar expects.
- **Crowd sourcing:** `crowdSourcing` is `true`, so visitors can propose new events.

Crowd sourcing still needs a contributions dataset. The schema lets you pick one under "Jeu de données des contributions externes", and I did not set one because you did not name it. Without one, proposed events have nowhere to go. Tell me which dataset should receive the contributions and I'll add it.
